parts AS (SELECT s, instr(lower(s),'e') AS e, substr(s,20) AS suffix FROM v),
mant AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN e=0 THEN s ELSE substr(s,1,e-1) END AS m, CASE WHEN e=0 THEN '' ELSE substr(s,e+1) END AS ex FROM parts),
signs AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN substr(m,1,1) IN ('+','-') THEN substr(m,2) ELSE m END AS um, CASE WHEN substr(ex,1,1) IN ('+','-') THEN substr(ex,2) ELSE ex END AS ux FROM mant),
dateparts AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN substr(suffix,1,1) = '.' THEN ltrim(substr(suffix,2),'0123456789') ELSE suffix END AS zone FROM signs)

(length(um)>0 AND length(replace(um,'.',''))>0 AND um NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*' AND length(um)-length(replace(um,'.',''))<=1 AND (e=0 OR (length(ux)>0 AND ux NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')) AND abs(CAST(s AS REAL)) <= 9007199254740991)
(length(s)>=19 AND substr(s,5,1)='-' AND substr(s,8,1)='-' AND substr(s,11,1) IN (' ','T') AND substr(s,14,1)=':' AND substr(s,17,1)=':'

AND substr(s,1,4) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND substr(s,6,2) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND substr(s,9,2) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND substr(s,12,2) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND substr(s,15,2) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND substr(s,18,2) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
AND CAST(substr(s,6,2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 12

AND CAST(substr(s,9,2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND (CASE CAST(substr(s,6,2) AS INTEGER) WHEN 2 THEN CASE WHEN CAST(substr(s,1,4) AS INTEGER)%4=0 AND (CAST(substr(s,1,4) AS INTEGER)%100!=0 OR CAST(substr(s,1,4) AS INTEGER)%400=0) THEN 29 ELSE 28 END WHEN 4 THEN 30 WHEN 6 THEN 30 WHEN 9 THEN 30 WHEN 11 THEN 30 ELSE 31 END)
AND CAST(substr(s,12,2) AS INTEGER)<=23 AND CAST(substr(s,15,2) AS INTEGER)<=59 AND CAST(substr(s,18,2) AS INTEGER)<=59

AND (zone IN ('','Z') OR (substr(zone,1,1) IN ('+','-') AND ((length(zone)=3 AND substr(zone,2,2) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*') OR (length(zone)=5 AND substr(zone,2,4) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*') OR (length(zone)=6 AND substr(zone,4,1)=':' AND (substr(zone,2,2)||substr(zone,5,2)) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')) AND CAST(substr(zone,2,2) AS INTEGER)<=23 AND (length(zone)=3 OR CAST(substr(zone,length(zone)-1,2) AS INTEGER)<=59)))
